parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing exposure is documented, not hypothetical: the interior ministry deports foreign nationals suspected of being gay or trans with no charge upheld (12 incidents, 2018–2022), and a March 2026 overview confirms morality/sex-work provisions still routinely used for arrests carrying prison sentences. Dating-app entrapment targets transgender women specifically; custody carries documented abuse and coerced anal examinations; no anti-discrimination protection exists. This is state-tolerated targeting (tier 2), with removal power reaching every outed visitor. Society is overwhelmingly hostile (undated 95% figure), and legal gender recognition is being actively closed. Mitigations: no explicit presentation statute, no documented trans-specific killings, most forced-examination incidents dated 2017 (absence of documentation, not proof of change), and no documented trans-specific border screening protocol. Those do not offset the deportation power and arrest practice, placing this below 0.25 anchors that lack a direct removal mechanism.
